cards.mood: The track establishes a mysterious and commanding atmosphere from the outset, maintaining a steady, hypnotic tension throughout the verses.
cards.vocal: A single male vocalist delivers the performance with a smooth, mid-range baritone timbre that carries a slightly raspy, intimate texture.
cards.palette: A deep, sustained 808 sub-bass serves as the harmonic anchor, present throughout the entire track, providing a dark, rumbling foundation that follows the chord changes.
